items.title: Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard
items.snippet: Coding agents work in tasks, and the number that matters is cost per solved task, not price per token. In this post, you use the AWS CDK to deploy LiteLLM with the NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard routing plugin on Amazon Bedrock, then measure cost per solved task for a routed model group against single-model baselines.

items.title: Architecture patterns for fast session startup on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime

items.title: datasette-leaflet 0.3
items.snippet: Release: datasette-leaflet 0.3 OpenStreetMap have a very reasonable policy that hits to their hosted tile server should send a referrer header . Datasette table pages used the Referrer-Policy: no-referrer HTTP header, causing plugins that loaded tiles from OpenStreetMap to violate that policy. datasette-leaflet is the plugin that loads a bundled Leaflet so other Datasette plugins can depend on it.
